model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for three different model configurations. The x-axis represents the number of completions (*k*), displayed on a logarithmic (base-2) scale ranging from 2⁰ (1) to 2⁸ (256), with tick labels at each power of two. The y-axis represents coverage on a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.4 to 0.9, with tick marks at 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and unlabeled gridlines in between. Three lines are shown. The first, labeled "Llama-3B," is depicted as a solid blue line with filled circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.43 at k = 1 and increases steadily, reaching approximately 0.90 at k = 256, with a concave shape indicating diminishing gains at higher values of k. The second, labeled "Llama-1B," is shown as a solid light purple/gray line with filled circle markers; it starts at approximately 0.42 at k = 1 and rises to approximately 0.88 at k = 256, following a similar trajectory but consistently slightly below the Llama-3B line. The third, labeled "Llama-1B + FT," is displayed as a dashed green line with triangle markers; it starts at approximately 0.43 at k = 1 and increases to approximately 0.90 at k = 256, tracking closely with or slightly above the Llama-3B line across most of the range, particularly in the mid-range values around k = 4 to k = 32 where it appears to slightly exceed the Llama-3B curve.
